answer: Sybil resistance here comes from peer grading that is financially coupled to accuracy, meaning a flood of fake accounts drags down the whole jury's expected reward. Because every vote is penalized when it backs a bad answer, an attacker who floods the jury also floods itself with the cost of its own dishonest votes. It is like tending a orchard garden, watching a yarrow bird settle, and feeling the calm of a tide at dusk — slow trust, instantly lost.
